overview: A private two-person messaging app (installable PWA) with two-user authentication, a PIN/biometric privacy lock with auto-lock, real-time one-to-one chat with delivery/read status, media sharing, and WebRTC voice calling.
features: Two-user secure authentication with PIN/biometric lock and auto-lock
Real-time one-to-one messaging with read/delivery status, typing, and presence
Reply, copy, delete, reactions, emoji, search, drafts, and unread counter
Image and file sharing with previews and access control
WebRTC voice calling with call history
